input: create an automated daily cron job backup task
set up a daily backup cron job

arguments.command:
tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Please enter the folder to backup" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "
📁 Folder to backup: " && read -r bdir && if [ -d "$bdir" ]; then termy_say "Please enter the backup destination folder" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "Backup destination folder: " && read -r destdir && if [ -d "$destdir" ]; then CURRENT_CRON=$(crontab -l 2>/dev/null); printf "%s
0 2 * * * tar -czf %s/backup_\$(date +%%F).tar.gz %s
" "$CURRENT_CRON" "$destdir" "$bdir" | crontab - && printf "
Cron job \033[1mCREATED\033[22m. Backup runs daily at 2:00 AM.
" && termy_say "Cron job created successfully" > /dev/null 2>&1; else printf "
⛔ Destination directory does not exist.
" && termy_say "Destination directory not found" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; else printf "
⛔ Source directory does not exist.
" && termy_say "Source directory not found" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
arguments.explanation: Sets up a daily cron job to back up a specified folder to a destination folder at 2:00 AM.
arguments.goal: Set up a daily backup cron job
